title: Digital Personal Data Protection Rules, 2025
summary: MeitY notified the Digital Personal Data Protection Rules, 2025 in November 2025 under the DPDP Act, 2023, after publishing a draft for public comment in January 2025. The Rules set out how notices are given, how consent managers register, security and breach-reporting duties, verifiable parental consent for children's data, extra duties such as annual audits for significant data fiduciaries, and how the Data Protection Board works. Board rules applied at once; consent-manager rules apply after 12 months and most fiduciary duties after 18 months (May 2027). In early 2026 MeitY consulted industry on shortening the 18-month window, but no amending instrument had been found as of October 2026.
key_obligations: Notices must itemise data collected, purpose and how to withdraw consent
Consent managers must register with the Data Protection Board
Significant data fiduciaries must undergo a compliance audit every 12 months
Verifiable consent of an adult parent needed for children's data
